pages.text: The physical and mental security of a walled fortress. Protection spirits gather in hard materials, shields, and armor.$(br2)When a player or bound/tamed mob takes damage in range of a protection shrine, the shrine will try to spend spirits equal to thrice the damage.

This will halve the damage taken. The effects of multiple shrines stack. A protection shrine will also spend nine spirits to nullify any mob griefing in its range (unless performed by a bound/tamed mob). Modded mobs might circumvent this.$(br2)Farmland will not become trampled in the range of a protection shrine.
